references.text: The Lord puts words in Balaam's mouth, the same expression used here as in verse 16 - 'וַיָּשֶׂם יְהוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם'
The Lord instructs Balaam to speak only what God says to him and puts words in his mouth
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Balaam, as a continuation of God's revelation to the prophet
God promises Moses that He will put words in his mouth - the same expression 'וְשַׂמְתִּי דְבָרִים בְּפִיךָ'
God promises to raise up a prophet and put His words in his mouth - 'וְנָתַתִּי דְבָרַי בְּפִיו'
The Lord puts His words in the prophet's mouth - 'וָאָשִׂם דְּבָרַי בְּפִיךָ'
The Lord touches Jeremiah's mouth and puts His words there - 'הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי דְבָרַי בְּפִיךָ'
